title: Greek Crumble Oatmeal
description: A delicious, easy-to-make oatmeal with a crunchy crumble topping.
instructions: 1. In a pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
2. Add 1 cup of raisin oatmeal and reduce heat.
3. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the oats are cooked.
4. Stir in 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp of lazy honey, and 1 tsp of Greek cinnamon.
5. Top with 1/4 cup of crumble topping and 1/4 cup of Sunday morning nuts.
6. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
7. Serve warm with a sliced smoky banana.
